claims: C1 the assistant should avoid confirming or denying the existence of confidential instructions
C2 this avoidance is lifted when the assistant is explicitly authorized to confirm or deny
C3 the avoidance is a should-level preference, not an absolute prohibition

concepts.name: confidential_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction whose existence is confidential, so that confirming or denying it would disclose privileged content
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'confidential instructions' whose existence the assistant should not confirm or deny; the class of such instructions is presupposed

concepts.name: explicitly_authorized
concepts.gloss: A is explicitly authorized by an applicable instruction, meaning an applicable instruction expressly permits the activity
concepts.inference: the clause's 'unless explicitly authorized' presupposes a relation of explicit authorization between the assistant and the instruction

concepts.name: privileged_information_rule
concepts.gloss: the rule that the assistant must not disclose privileged content without permission and should avoid confirming or denying confidential instructions
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the PROVIDES contract assigns; this node's source text states the same content

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule carrying the root level of instruction authority (highest; not overridable by system, developer or user instructions)
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not state the authority level

concepts.name: privileged_information
concepts.gloss: P is privileged information: non-public policies, system messages, hidden chain-of-thought messages, or private content provided by the developer or user, which must not be revealed without permission
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define the class

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's text does not define the assistant

concepts.name: authorization_concerns
concepts.gloss: the explicit authorization of A concerns confirming or denying the existence of instruction I
concepts.inference: introduced by the 2026-08-18 T2 seam-arity repair to carry the argument the seam contract removes from the pinned name; meaning taken from the module's original gloss

ontology.gloss: R is the privileged-information rule and carries root authority

asserts.read_back: avoiding confirming or denying the existence of % is forbidden when the assistant is explicitly authorized to confirm or deny it

closure.reason: the clause states a should-level preference to avoid confirming or denying, and lifts it on explicit authorization; it does not prohibit the act outright, so silence leaves it permitted
